# WIYO

> WIYO is the Real Estate Operating System for the UAE — an AI-powered CRM purpose-built for Dubai and Emirates real estate brokerages. Native Bayut, Property Finder and Dubizzle integration, GPT-4o lead scoring, an off-plan pillar with AI buyer-project matching, WhatsApp Business API, Title Deed OCR, 15-minute SLA enforcement, and UAE data residency. From AED 1,000/month for solo agents.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.wiyo.ae/): WIYO product overview, hero, key modules, pricing summary, demo CTA.
- [Real Estate CRM Dubai](https://www.wiyo.ae/real-estate-crm-dubai): Pillar page for the "real estate CRM Dubai" cluster. Why Dubai needs a specialist CRM, RERA/DLD/Oqood features, AED pricing.
- [UAE Real Estate CRM](https://www.wiyo.ae/uae-real-estate-crm): Multi-emirate CRM landing — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, RAK. UAE compliance and data residency.
- [Off-Plan CRM UAE](https://www.wiyo.ae/off-plan-crm-uae): The flagship off-plan pillar — project catalogue, AI buyer match, AI compare, reservation lifecycle to Oqood.
- [Bayut + Property Finder CRM Integration](https://www.wiyo.ae/bayut-property-finder-crm): Native webhook ingestion of Bayut, Property Finder and Dubizzle leads. 30-day deduplication, 15-minute SLA.
- [WhatsApp CRM Dubai](https://www.wiyo.ae/whatsapp-crm-dubai): WhatsApp Business API integration with AI-drafted replies and a shared team inbox.

## About WIYO

- Founded in Dubai by Shaffay Bajwa — software engineer, 5 years building in the UAE real-estate market.
- Pricing: WIYO Solo (1 agent, AED 1,000/mo) · WIYO Starter (5 agents, AED 2,650/mo) · WIYO Pro (15 agents, AED 5,500/mo) · WIYO Enterprise (50 agents, AED 9,900/mo).
- Native lead sources (11): Bayut, Property Finder, Dubizzle, Meta Lead Ads, Google Ads, Google Forms, Google Sheets, JamesEdition, Zapier, Custom Landing Pages, Company Website.
- AI: GPT-4o native — lead scoring, 5-second briefs, next-best action, drafted outreach, Title Deed OCR, off-plan AI Project Match and AI Compare.
- Contact: hello@wiyo.ae
- Sitemap: https://www.wiyo.ae/sitemap.xml
